title: The batch runner runs a rolling combine train as a standing duty
ruling: Owner 21:48 CST Nov 13, in runner 10's chat, relayed by the consultant at 21:49 (triage did not see it; the retrospective agrees): the combining should be sort of continuous, so that lane PRs keep getting combined and batched behind the tournament, making the runner a scaling machine; if the idea is sound, relay it to the retrospective and make it part of how a batch runner is briefed or operates. The consultant's reading: a batch closes when its real PR is built and linted; later hand-ins join the next batch; clashing members leave by name; each merge report gives members in, left out, clash rate, dry-round, lint and CI minutes; review after 3 batches against lone merges. Homes: decision session-tiers and the project-ops batch-runner template, via a lane. Merges stay serial. Filed as step batch-runner-rolling-train.
